sources.title: 2015 Michigan Residential Code
sources.notes: Listed current. Adoption includes Michigan-specific amendments. Scope requires occupancy classification and work/permit history.

sources.notes: July 7, 2025 court order prevented implementation of planned August 29, 2025 residential update; do not promote to current without re-verification.

sources.title: Proposed 2021 residential energy update
sources.notes: Proposed residential energy adoption subject to July 2025 stipulated order.

sources.title: 2021 Michigan Building Code
sources.notes: General building code; residential one/two-family scope is addressed by the Michigan Residential Code.

sources.title: 2021 Michigan Rehabilitation Code for Existing Buildings
sources.notes: Applicability depends on existing-building work and adopted rules; ordinary visual inspection does not establish retrofit duty.

sources.title: 2021 Michigan Mechanical Code
sources.notes: Michigan residential code generally contains one-/two-family requirements; verify applicable specialty rules and permits.

sources.title: 2021 Michigan Plumbing Code
sources.notes: Michigan residential code generally contains one-/two-family requirements; verify applicable specialty rules and permits.

sources.title: 2023 National Electrical Code with Michigan Part 8 amendments
sources.notes: NEC referenced with Michigan amendments; confirm scope and dates with AHJ. Do not overlook MRC residential provisions.

sources.title: 2021 Michigan Commercial Energy Code
sources.notes: Commercial energy code; not a stand-in for Michigan residential energy provisions.
